audience: MSPs and sales teams that prepare quotes and proposals in Quoter

useCases.title: Review draft quotes and their status
useCases.text: List quotes filtered by draft flag, status, email status or creation date. Each row shows the contact and totals.

useCases.title: Find a contact and read the billing address
useCases.text: Search contacts by email, city, country or region. Open one contact for its billing and shipping address.

useCases.title: Look up catalog items and their prices
useCases.text: Filter catalog items by name, code, SKU or category. Open one item for its prices, cost, manufacturer and supplier.

useCases.title: Create a quote from a template and add lines
useCases.text: Create a quote for a contact from a quote template. Then add a line item with its quantity and prices.

useCases.title: Add a customer contact or update one
useCases.text: Create a customer contact with its required fields, or change some fields of an existing contact.
